Subject: Invite to join DataCloud guest panel — run-of-show and tech check

Hi Emily,

Thanks again for agreeing to join our webinar panel on scaling retrieval-augmented LLMs on May 28. We want to make the session as smooth and valuable as possible for attendees, so I attached a draft run-of-show and a short speaker prep doc. Can you confirm:

- Whether the proposed 20-minute segment + 10-minute live Q&A works for you
- Any AV / demo requirements (screen share, sample dataset, console access)
- A brief bio and preferred headshot (I attached a template)

We'd also like to schedule a 20-minute tech check the week before (we're proposing Tue 5/26 at 10:00 PDT). Are you available then?

Attachments: draft_run_of_show.pdf, speaker_bio_template.docx

Appreciate it — excited to have you.

Best,
Tessa Morgan
Field Marketing Manager
Redwood Inference

Hi Tessa,

Really excited to participate. 20 + 10 works fine. For AV: I will screen-share a short demo of our retrieval pipeline (Chrome & slides). No special infra access required — just the ability to share my browser and audio.

I attached my speaker bio (speaker_bio_emily.docx) and a headshot. Tue 5/26 at 10:00 PDT works for the tech check. Can you send a calendar invite with the Zoom link and the run-of-show?
